how_to_apply: Candidates can apply only through the official online portal. No other mode of application is accepted. Follow these steps:
Visit the official application portal at recruitment.skau.ac.in/nonteaching
Register compulsorily using Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) or Mobile Number
After registration, a login ID will be created; complete registration using this login ID
Log in and fill up the online application form as per your qualifications and the post applied for
Pay the requisite application fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, or Credit Card
Upload all required scanned documents, photo, and signature
Download and take a printout of the submitted application form
Sign every page of the printed application form and upload the scanned, signed copy
Retain a printed copy of the finally submitted application for future reference
Note: The application process is complete only after uploading the duly signed scanned copy of the downloaded application form. Paying the fee alone does not complete the application.
important_instructions: Candidates must ensure they fulfill all eligibility conditions for the post before applying; admission to the recruitment process is purely provisional Issuance of an e-Admit Card does not imply that a candidate's eligibility has been finally cleared by the University Eligibility with regard to age, qualification, and experience will be determined as on the closing date (28.08.2026) Certificates issued after the closing date will not be accepted No change in application particulars will be entertained after final submission Only single application per post is advised; if multiple applications are submitted, only the last successfully submitted one will be considered No request for withdrawal of candidature will be entertained after submission The University reserves the right to increase, decrease, withdraw, or amend any advertised post without assigning reasons Use of mobile phones (even switched off), pagers, or any electronic/communication device is strictly prohibited during examination

content_sections.heading: SKAU Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: 1. Staff Nurse Matric, and A Grade Nurse registered with the Haryana Nurses Registration Council or its equivalent, and Matric with Hindi or Sanskrit as one of the subjects, or 10+2/BA/MA with Hindi as one of the subjects 2. Ayurvedic Pharmacist Up-Vaidya from any recognized University/Institution/Board/Faculty of Indian System of Medicine, or Diploma in Ayurvedic Pharmacy from a recognized institution, along with 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology Plus Matric with Hindi or Sanskrit, or 10+2/BA/MA with Hindi as one of the subjects 3. Clerk Graduate from a recognized University (or, for Ex-Servicemen, pensionable service with a 1st Class Army Certificate, OR a Graduate Certificate issued by the competent authority of Defence Services) Must qualify a written test of language/General Knowledge of graduation standard Must qualify a data entry test at 30 words per minute, including basic computer/internet/email skills Matric with Hindi or Sanskrit, or 10+2/BA/MA with Hindi as one of the subjects Must qualify the State Eligibility Test in Computer Appreciation and Applications (SETC) within the two-year probation period (extendable by one year) Candidates must have attained 18 years of age and must not be more than 42 years as on the closing date of application (21.08.2026). Age relaxation is available as per Haryana Government instructions: Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes of Haryana: 5 years Persons with Benchmark Disabilities: 5 years (additional 5 years if belonging to SC/ST/BC/EWS, subject to a maximum of 52 years, for Group A & B posts) Widowed or legally divorced women: 5 years Judicially separated women (residing separately for over two years): 5 years Unmarried women: 5 years Ex-servicemen: relaxation equal to military service rendered, plus 3 years Persons already working on adhoc/contract/work-charged/daily wages basis in a Haryana Government Department/Board/Corporation: relaxation equal to completed years of service, subject to a maximum age of 52 years The overall upper age limit for any category (except Ex-Servicemen) cannot exceed 52 years even after availing multiple relaxations. A candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who arrived in India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of permanent settlement, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from specified countries with the intention of permanently settling in India (subject to an eligibility certificate from the Government of India for the latter categories).

content_sections.heading: SKAU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a total of 100 marks, distributed as follows: Written Test (Phase 1) subject-wise question distribution: There is no negative marking. The post-candidate ratio for shortlisting to Physical Document Verification will be 1:5 in each category, based on combined marks from the Written Test and Academic Achievements. Selection is based on a total of 100 marks, distributed across three phases: Typing Test marking formula: minimum qualifying speed is 30 Net Words Per Minute (NWPM). Marks are awarded at 0.5 per NWPM above 30, subject to a maximum of 15 marks - i.e., (NWPM - 30) x 0.5. Written Test (Phase 2) subject-wise question distribution: Academic Achievements (Phase 3) for Clerk: 10th (5 marks), 12th (5 marks), Graduation (5 marks), calculated on a percentage basis. There is no negative marking in the Written Test. In case of bracketed/tied candidates, the following order applies: Age: The elder candidate is considered senior Name: If date of birth is also the same, the candidate whose name comes first alphabetically in English is considered senior Father's Name: If the tie still persists, the candidate whose father's name comes first alphabetically in English is considered senior

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for SKAU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload scanned copies of the following documents with the online application form: Scanned photo duly signed by the candidate Scanned signature of the candidate Scanned copies of degrees and mark sheets of educational qualifications DSC/OSC certificate of Haryana (if applicable) BC-A/BC-B certificate issued for the year 2026-27 (if applicable) EWS certificate valid for the year 2026-27 (if applicable) DESM (Dependent of Ex-Serviceman) certificate for the year 2026-27 (if applicable) ESM/DFF (Dependent of Freedom Fighter) certificate (if applicable) PwBD certificate (for PwBD category candidates) Aadhaar card Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP), if availing reservation benefits Haryana Domicile Certificate (if availing reservation benefits) Experience certificate (if applicable) NOC from the department (for Haryana Government employees who have signed a bond) Proof of Adhoc/Contract/Work-charged/Daily wages service (for candidates claiming age relaxation) At the time of Physical Document Verification, candidates must bring original documents along with two sets of self-attested photocopies, including License/Passport/Voter Card/PAN Card/Aadhar Card, Matric Certificate, 10+2 Certificate, Diploma/Degree certificates, category certificates, NOC (if in service), and printed copies of the online application form with photograph.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for SKAU Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply only through the official online portal. No other mode of application is accepted. Follow these steps: Visit the official application portal at recruitment.skau.ac.in/nonteaching Register compulsorily using Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) or Mobile Number After registration, a login ID will be created; complete registration using this login ID Log in and fill up the online application form as per your qualifications and the post applied for Pay the requisite application fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, or Credit Card Upload all required scanned documents, photo, and signature Download and take a printout of the submitted application form Sign every page of the printed application form and upload the scanned, signed copy Retain a printed copy of the finally submitted application for future reference Note: The application process is complete only after uploading the duly signed scanned copy of the downloaded application form. Paying the fee alone does not complete the application.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SKAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date for payment of fees, submission of the online application, and uploading of the signed application form is 28.08.2026, up to 04:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SKAU Kurukshetra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 60 vacancies have been advertised across three posts - Staff Nurse (25), Ayurvedic Pharmacist (6), and Clerk (29).

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility for the SKAU Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matric, hold A Grade Nurse registration with the Haryana Nurses Registration Council (or equivalent), and meet the Hindi/Sanskrit subject requirement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SKAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 18 years old and not more than 42 years old as on the closing date, with relaxations available for reserved categories as per Haryana Government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SKAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee ranges from Rs. 1,500/- for male general category and other-state candidates, Rs. 750/- for Haryana female general category candidates, Rs. 375/- for OSC/DSC/BC-A/BC-B/ESM/EWS candidates of Haryana, and NIL for PwBD candidates with at least 40% disability.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for SKAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only, through recruitment.skau.ac.in/nonteaching. No offline or postal applications are accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the SKAU Clerk post?
faq.answer: The Clerk post carries a pay scale of FPL-2 (Rs. 19,900 - 63,200), subject to qualifying the State Eligibility Test in Computer Appreciation and Applications (SETC) within the probation period.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Ayurvedic Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a Written Test (MCQ, 90 marks) and Academic Achievements verified at the Document Verification stage (10 marks), for a total of 100 marks.
